+/// Environment variables that carry campaign lineage across the spawn boundary.
+/// The meta-coordinator sets these on each sub-orchestrator subprocess; the
+/// sub-orchestrator reads them at startup (before it has a plan dir) to learn its
+/// depth, and writes its result to the sidecar named by [`ENV_SUB_RESULT`].
+pub const ENV_DEPTH: &str = "DEADRECKON_CAMPAIGN_DEPTH";
+pub const ENV_ROOT: &str = "DEADRECKON_CAMPAIGN_ROOT";
+pub const ENV_ANCESTOR_TASK_KEYS: &str = "DEADRECKON_CAMPAIGN_ANCESTOR_TASK_KEYS";
+pub const ENV_ANCESTOR_SCOPES: &str = "DEADRECKON_CAMPAIGN_ANCESTOR_SCOPES";
+pub const ENV_SUB_RESULT: &str = "DEADRECKON_CAMPAIGN_SUB_RESULT";
+
+const SUB_RESULT_FILE: &str = "sub-result.json";
+
+/// What a sub-orchestrator reports back to the meta-coordinator: the plan it ran
+/// and the normal run its merge promoted. Written to `<launch-dir>/sub-result.json`.
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
+pub struct SubResult {
+    pub schema_version: u32,
+    pub sub_id: String,
+    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
+    pub plan_id: Option<String>,
+    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
+    pub result_run_id: Option<String>,
+    pub ok: bool,
+}
+
+pub fn sub_result_path(launch_dir: &Path) -> PathBuf {
+    launch_dir.join(SUB_RESULT_FILE)
+}
+
+pub fn read_sub_result(launch_dir: &Path) -> Result<Option<SubResult>> {
+    let path = sub_result_path(launch_dir);
+    match std::fs::read(&path) {
+        Ok(bytes) => serde_json::from_slice(&bytes)
+            .map(Some)
+            .map_err(|source| DeadreckonError::Json { path, source }),
+        Err(source) if source.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => Ok(None),
+        Err(source) => Err(DeadreckonError::Io { path, source }),
+    }
+}
+
+pub fn write_sub_result(launch_dir: &Path, result: &SubResult) -> Result<()> {
+    crate::state::atomic_write_json(&sub_result_path(launch_dir), result)
+}
+
+/// Build a [`Lineage`] from the campaign env-var values (any may be absent). This
+/// is the pure core of reading lineage out of the process environment; absent
+/// depth means depth 0 (a top-level invocation).
+pub fn parse_lineage(
+    depth: Option<&str>,
+    campaign_root_id: Option<&str>,
+    ancestor_task_keys: Option<&str>,
+    ancestor_scopes: Option<&str>,
+) -> Lineage {
+    let split = |value: Option<&str>| -> Vec<String> {
+        value
+            .map(|raw| {
+                raw.split(',')
+                    .map(str::trim)
+                    .filter(|item| !item.is_empty())
+                    .map(ToString::to_string)
+                    .collect()
+            })
+            .unwrap_or_default()
+    };
+    Lineage {
+        schema_version: 1,
+        depth: depth.and_then(|raw| raw.trim().parse().ok()).unwrap_or(0),
+        campaign_root_id: campaign_root_id
+            .map(str::trim)
+            .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
+            .map(ToString::to_string),
+        ancestor_task_keys: split(ancestor_task_keys),
+        ancestor_scopes: split(ancestor_scopes),
+    }
+}
+
+/// Read the campaign lineage from the current process environment.
+pub fn lineage_from_env() -> Lineage {
+    parse_lineage(
+        std::env::var(ENV_DEPTH).ok().as_deref(),
+        std::env::var(ENV_ROOT).ok().as_deref(),
+        std::env::var(ENV_ANCESTOR_TASK_KEYS).ok().as_deref(),
+        std::env::var(ENV_ANCESTOR_SCOPES).ok().as_deref(),
+    )
+}

+// --- Campaign: sub-orchestrator spawn (P3) ---------------------------------
+// A campaign launches each sub-goal as a full `orchestrate full-plan`
+// subprocess, isolated by DEADRECKON_SCOPE_ROOT exactly like a plan child, plus
+// the campaign lineage env so a depth-1 process refuses to fan out again. The
+// sub reports back through a sub-result.json sidecar in its launch dir.
+
+#[allow(dead_code)] // fields/fn wired by the campaign fork in P4
+struct CampaignSubLaunch<'a> {
+    home: &'a Path,
+    source_dir: &'a Path,
+    launch_dir: &'a Path,
+    campaign_id: &'a str,
+    sub_goal: &'a str,
+    sub_n: u8,
+    sandbox: &'a str,
+    max_spend: Option<f64>,
+    plain: bool,
+    planner_provider: Option<&'a str>,
+    child_provider: Option<&'a str>,
+    ancestor_task_keys: &'a [String],
+    ancestor_scopes: &'a [String],
+}
+
+#[allow(dead_code)] // wired by the campaign fork in P4
+fn build_sub_orchestrator_command(launch: &CampaignSubLaunch<'_>) -> Result<std::process::Command> {
+    use deadreckon_core::campaign;
+    let mut command = std::process::Command::new(std::env::current_exe()?);
+    command
+        .current_dir(launch.source_dir)
+        .env("DEADRECKON_HOME", launch.home)
+        .env("DEADRECKON_HINTS", "0")
+        .env("DEADRECKON_SCOPE_ROOT", launch.launch_dir)
+        .env(campaign::ENV_DEPTH, "1")
+        .env(campaign::ENV_ROOT, launch.campaign_id)
+        .env(campaign::ENV_SUB_RESULT, launch.launch_dir);
+    if !launch.ancestor_task_keys.is_empty() {
+        command.env(
+            campaign::ENV_ANCESTOR_TASK_KEYS,
+            launch.ancestor_task_keys.join(","),
+        );
+    }
+    if !launch.ancestor_scopes.is_empty() {
+        command.env(
+            campaign::ENV_ANCESTOR_SCOPES,
+            launch.ancestor_scopes.join(","),
+        );
+    }
+    command
+        .arg("orchestrate")
+        .arg("full-plan")
+        .arg(launch.sub_goal)
+        .arg("--n")
+        .arg(launch.sub_n.to_string())
+        .arg("--yes")
+        .arg("--no-hints")
+        .arg("--sandbox")
+        .arg(launch.sandbox);
+    if launch.plain {
+        command.arg("--plain");
+    }
+    if let Some(max_spend) = launch.max_spend {
+        command.arg("--max-spend").arg(format!("{max_spend:.6}"));
+    }
+    if let Some(planner) = launch.planner_provider {
+        command.arg("--planner-provider").arg(planner);
+    }
+    if let Some(provider) = launch.child_provider {
+        command.arg("--provider").arg(provider);
+    }
+    Ok(command)
+}
+

+fn discover_sub_result(launch_dir: &Path) -> Result<Option<deadreckon_core::campaign::SubResult>> {
+    deadreckon_core::campaign::read_sub_result(launch_dir).map_err(CliError::Core)
+}
+
+/// Write a sub-orchestrator's result sidecar. Called at the end of
+/// `orchestrate full-plan` when launched by a campaign (DEADRECKON_CAMPAIGN_SUB_RESULT
+/// is set): records the plan id and its merged result run for the meta-coordinator.
+fn record_sub_orchestrator_result(plan_id: &str, launch_dir: &Path, ok: bool) {
+    let paths = DeadreckonPaths::discover();
+    let result_run_id = deadreckon_core::plan::load_plan(&paths, plan_id)
+        .ok()
+        .and_then(|plan| plan.merged_run_id);
+    let sub_id = launch_dir
+        .file_name()
+        .and_then(|name| name.to_str())
+        .unwrap_or("sub")
+        .to_string();
+    let result = deadreckon_core::campaign::SubResult {
+        schema_version: 1,
+        sub_id,
+        plan_id: Some(plan_id.to_string()),
+        result_run_id,
+        ok,
+    };
+    let _ = deadreckon_core::campaign::write_sub_result(launch_dir, &result);
+}
+

21	/// orchestrators it launches sit at depth 1; a depth-1 process is forbidden from
22	/// launching a campaign (its sub-orchestrators would reach depth 2). Not

78	/// Guard a requested campaign against the depth cap and ancestor cycles.
79	///
80	/// `current_depth` is the depth of the process requesting the campaign (0 for a
81	/// top-level invocation, 1 for a sub-orchestrator). The sub-orchestrators a
82	/// campaign launches sit at `current_depth + 1`; if that would reach
83	/// [`CAMPAIGN_MAX_DEPTH`] the campaign is refused. A requested sub-goal whose
84	/// `task_key` or resolved scope matches an ancestor's is refused as a cycle.
85	pub fn guard(
86	    current_depth: u32,
87	    ancestor_task_keys: &[String],
88	    ancestor_scopes: &[String],
89	    requested_sub_task_keys: &[String],
90	    requested_sub_scopes: &[String],
91	) -> Result<()> {
92	    if current_depth + 1 >= CAMPAIGN_MAX_DEPTH {
93	        return Err(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(format!(
94	            "campaign refused: depth cap {CAMPAIGN_MAX_DEPTH} reached\n\
95	             try: run `orchestrate full-plan` (not campaign) inside a sub-orchestrator"
96	        )));
97	    }
98	    for key in requested_sub_task_keys {
99	        if ancestor_task_keys.iter().any(|ancestor| ancestor == key) {
100	            return Err(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(format!(
101	                "campaign refused: sub-goal task_key '{key}' cycles to an ancestor\n\
102	                 try: reword the sub-goal so its task differs from an ancestor"
103	            )));
104	        }
105	    }
106	    for scope in requested_sub_scopes {
107	        if ancestor_scopes.iter().any(|ancestor| ancestor == scope) {
108	            return Err(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(format!(
109	                "campaign refused: sub-goal scope '{scope}' cycles to an ancestor\n\
110	                 try: launch the campaign from a different checkout"
111	            )));
112	        }
113	    }
114	    Ok(())
115	}

228	/// Turn planner output (N sub-goal strings) into validated [`SubGoal`]s. Refuses a
229	/// count that does not match the request, an empty sub-goal, or a duplicate
230	/// (whitespace- and case-normalized).
231	pub fn build_sub_goals(goals: Vec<String>, requested_n: usize) -> Result<Vec<SubGoal>> {
232	    if goals.len() != requested_n {
233	        return Err(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(format!(
234	            "campaign planner returned {} sub-goals; expected exactly {requested_n}",
235	            goals.len()
236	        )));
237	    }
238	    validate_task_count(goals.len())?;
239	    let mut seen = BTreeSet::new();
240	    let mut subs = Vec::with_capacity(goals.len());
241	    for (index, goal) in goals.into_iter().enumerate() {
242	        let trimmed = goal.trim();
243	        if trimmed.is_empty() {
244	            return Err(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(
245	                "campaign sub-goal must not be empty".to_string(),
246	            ));
247	        }
248	        let normalized = trimmed
249	            .split_whitespace()
250	            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
251	            .join(" ")
252	            .to_ascii_lowercase();
253	        if !seen.insert(normalized) {
254	            return Err(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(format!(
255	                "duplicate campaign sub-goal: {trimmed}"
256	            )));
257	        }
258	        subs.push(SubGoal {
259	            sub_id: format!("sub-{index}"),
260	            goal: trimmed.to_string(),
261	            task_key: crate::paths::task_key(trimmed),
262	            sub_plan_id: None,
263	            result_run_id: None,
264	            scope: None,
265	            status: SubGoalStatus::Pending,
266	        });
267	    }
268	    Ok(subs)
269	}

288	/// Environment variables that carry campaign lineage across the spawn boundary.
289	/// The meta-coordinator sets these on each sub-orchestrator subprocess; the
290	/// sub-orchestrator reads them at startup (before it has a plan dir) to learn its
291	/// depth, and writes its result to the sidecar named by [`ENV_SUB_RESULT`].
292	pub const ENV_DEPTH: &str = "DEADRECKON_CAMPAIGN_DEPTH";
293	pub const ENV_ROOT: &str = "DEADRECKON_CAMPAIGN_ROOT";
294	pub const ENV_ANCESTOR_TASK_KEYS: &str = "DEADRECKON_CAMPAIGN_ANCESTOR_TASK_KEYS";
295	pub const ENV_ANCESTOR_SCOPES: &str = "DEADRECKON_CAMPAIGN_ANCESTOR_SCOPES";
296	pub const ENV_SUB_RESULT: &str = "DEADRECKON_CAMPAIGN_SUB_RESULT";
297	
298	const SUB_RESULT_FILE: &str = "sub-result.json";
299	
300	/// What a sub-orchestrator reports back to the meta-coordinator: the plan it ran
301	/// and the normal run its merge promoted. Written to `<launch-dir>/sub-result.json`.
302	#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
303	pub struct SubResult {
304	    pub schema_version: u32,
305	    pub sub_id: String,
306	    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
307	    pub plan_id: Option<String>,
308	    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
309	    pub result_run_id: Option<String>,
310	    pub ok: bool,
311	}
312	
313	pub fn sub_result_path(launch_dir: &Path) -> PathBuf {
314	    launch_dir.join(SUB_RESULT_FILE)
315	}
316	
317	pub fn read_sub_result(launch_dir: &Path) -> Result<Option<SubResult>> {
318	    let path = sub_result_path(launch_dir);
319	    match std::fs::read(&path) {
320	        Ok(bytes) => serde_json::from_slice(&bytes)
321	            .map(Some)
322	            .map_err(|source| DeadreckonError::Json { path, source }),
323	        Err(source) if source.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => Ok(None),
324	        Err(source) => Err(DeadreckonError::Io { path, source }),
325	    }
326	}
327	
328	pub fn write_sub_result(launch_dir: &Path, result: &SubResult) -> Result<()> {
329	    crate::state::atomic_write_json(&sub_result_path(launch_dir), result)
330	}

332	/// Build a [`Lineage`] from the campaign env-var values (any may be absent). This
333	/// is the pure core of reading lineage out of the process environment; absent
334	/// depth means depth 0 (a top-level invocation).
335	pub fn parse_lineage(
336	    depth: Option<&str>,
337	    campaign_root_id: Option<&str>,
338	    ancestor_task_keys: Option<&str>,
339	    ancestor_scopes: Option<&str>,
340	) -> Lineage {
341	    let split = |value: Option<&str>| -> Vec<String> {
342	        value
343	            .map(|raw| {
344	                raw.split(',')
345	                    .map(str::trim)
346	                    .filter(|item| !item.is_empty())
347	                    .map(ToString::to_string)
348	                    .collect()
349	            })
350	            .unwrap_or_default()
351	    };
352	    Lineage {
353	        schema_version: 1,
354	        depth: depth.and_then(|raw| raw.trim().parse().ok()).unwrap_or(0),
355	        campaign_root_id: campaign_root_id
356	            .map(str::trim)
357	            .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
358	            .map(ToString::to_string),
359	        ancestor_task_keys: split(ancestor_task_keys),
360	        ancestor_scopes: split(ancestor_scopes),
361	    }
362	}
363	
364	/// Read the campaign lineage from the current process environment.
365	pub fn lineage_from_env() -> Lineage {
366	    parse_lineage(
367	        std::env::var(ENV_DEPTH).ok().as_deref(),
368	        std::env::var(ENV_ROOT).ok().as_deref(),
369	        std::env::var(ENV_ANCESTOR_TASK_KEYS).ok().as_deref(),
370	        std::env::var(ENV_ANCESTOR_SCOPES).ok().as_deref(),
371	    )
372	}

390	pub fn append_campaign_event(
391	    plan_dir: &Path,
392	    kind: impl Into<String>,
393	    detail: serde_json::Value,
394	) -> Result<()> {
395	    let event = CampaignEvent {
396	        schema_version: 1,
397	        ts: Utc::now(),
398	        kind: kind.into(),
399	        detail,
400	    };
401	    crate::state::append_json_line(&campaign_events_path(plan_dir), &event)
402	}

404	pub fn read_campaign_events(plan_dir: &Path) -> Result<Vec<CampaignEvent>> {
405	    let path = campaign_events_path(plan_dir);
406	    match std::fs::read_to_string(&path) {
407	        Ok(text) => text
408	            .lines()
409	            .filter(|line| !line.trim().is_empty())
410	            .map(|line| {
411	                serde_json::from_str(line).map_err(|source| DeadreckonError::Json {
412	                    path: path.clone(),
413	                    source,
414	                })
415	            })
416	            .collect(),
417	        Err(source) if source.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => Ok(Vec::new()),
418	        Err(source) => Err(DeadreckonError::Io { path, source }),
419	    }
420	}
